mapper.select: SELECT MAX(sd.price*sd.exchange_rate) AS maxPrice, MIN(sd.price*sd.exchange_rate) AS minPrice, sd.sku_id, COUNT(sd.sku_id) AS count, round( SUM (sd.amount_local_currency) / sum(sd.qty), 2 ) avgPrice FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND si.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sd.is_deleted=FALSE AND si.approve_status=#{approveStatus} AND sku_id!='' and qty!=0 GROUP BY sku_id

SELECT sd.id, sd.main_id, sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, sd.qty, sd.is_gift, sd.is_close, sd.remark, sd.delivery_status, si.approve_status FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE si.is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT si.id) FROM so_info si INNER JOIN so_detail sd ON si.id = sd.main_id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE si.is_deleted = FALSE AND si.approve_status = 'approve' AND sd.is_close = FALSE AND (sd.delivery_status = 'unShipped' OR sd.delivery_status = 'partialShipment')
${permissionSql}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT si.id) FROM so_info si WHERE si.is_deleted = FALSE AND si.approve_status = 'approve' AND ( -- 情况1：所有明细已发货 NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM so_detail sd WHERE sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE AND sd.delivery_status != 'completeShipment' ) OR -- 情况2：发货明细部分未发货并且发货明细已关闭 EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM so_detail sd WHERE sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE AND (sd.delivery_status = 'unShipped' OR sd.delivery_status = 'partialShipment') AND sd.is_close = TRUE ) )
${permissionSql}

select si.warehouse_id as warehouseId, si.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, sd.sku_id as skuId, sd.qty as orderQty, si.approve_status as approveStatus, sd.delivery_status as status, si.invalid_status as invalidStatus, si.id as sourceId, si.code as sourceCode, 'soInfo' as sourceType, sd.id as sourceDetailId, si.create_time as date, sd.frozen_qty as frozenQty from so_info si inner join so_detail sd on si.id = sd.main_id and sd.is_deleted = false
si.is_deleted = false and si.virtual_warehouse_id != ''
order by si.id desc
